title: Accelerate Susi Core workspace test suite under 60s (Wave 1: parallel xtask/release-qualify runner, deduplicated xtask mounts, cached templates/certs, and tightened test budgets)
goal: Eliminate serial test execution and multi-second idle/subprocess bottlenecks across Susi Core (Wave 1, strictly disjoint from active claims #45 and #109 and GMCP-digested sources): wire Susi's existing concurrent isolated-home binary runner (`xtask/src/test_runner.rs`) + companion `--doc` pass into `xtask test` and `release-qualify`; eliminate duplicate `#[cfg(test)]` execution across `#[path]`-mounted `xtask` binaries and add Git < 2.40 `merge-tree` fallback in `release_lanes.rs`; cache `cargo metadata`, workspace AST/source scans, Git fixture templates, and self-signed RSA test certificates in `OnceLock`; and tighten multi-second sleep/timeout soak waits while preserving every test assertion and security check.

reuse.searched: intellibitz/susi (xtask/src/test_runner.rs concurrent isolated-home binary runner, xtask/src/distill_compose.rs Git < 2.40 synthetic-base merge-tree fallback, xtask/src/fast_release.rs), intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (crates/susi-dev-workflow), and Cargo.lock / Rust std (std::sync::OnceLock in-process fixture/cert/metadata caching; zero new dependencies).
reuse.reason: Reuses Susi Core's existing concurrent isolated-home xtask/src/test_runner.rs and distill_compose.rs Git < 2.40 merge-tree fallback plus std::sync::OnceLock without adding external dependencies.
